messages.subject: Legend Manipulation
parts:
Dear All,

I am struggling to manipulate a graph legend in ggplot2. At this point
I have been able to change the legend title and key label. However, I
have not been able to change the size of the legend itself. I believe
the problem I'm encountering is related to the 'size' option in the
geom_point function, as the legend size is quite large (large symbols
in the legend key for one of the groups plotted) when using this
option and resumes normalcy if omitted. Also, how might I remove one
of the legends entirely, if desired (e.g., wt.del). Any assistance is
much appreciated!! Here is the code:

gg.reg1 <- lm(del ~ n.sess, weights=wt.del)
p <- ggplot(grief2, aes(n.sess,del))
p + geom_point(aes(size = wt.del, shape=factor(risk)),
position="jitter") +
scale_area()+
scale_shape(solid = FALSE, name="Risk Level",
breaks = c("1", "2", "3"), labels = c("normal", "at-risk",
"high-risk"))+
scale_size(to = c(3, 8))+
geom_smooth(method="lm",data= gg.reg1,se=FALSE)+
#theme_bw() #will remove grey background
opts(title='ES Differences by Group & Sessions',
plot.title=theme_text(size=13,face="bold"))+
scale_x_continuous('Sessions') + scale_y_continuous('Effect Size')

Thanks,

AC Del Re
